spec.name: sprint26_taker_imbalance_momentum_majors
spec.hypothesis: Taker-side order-flow imbalance predicts short-horizon price continuation (not reversion) in BTCUSD/ETHUSD, consistent with sprint23's strongly negative reversion result implying the opposite sign.
spec.power_argument: Target >=300 validation trades over remaining sprint window (~24 days to 9/25) across 2 symbols; entry_per_day_cap=8/symbol yields ~300-380 trades at typical fill rates, sufficient to detect a >=5bps net edge at t>2 given sprint23's realized cross-sectional variance.
